description: The `member-overridden` defect under a computed name: it compiles (ngc), Angular reflects no input for it and inherits the base's, and the field under the name is the knob's, so the input runs the knob's `Boolean` (core's `writeToDirectiveInput`) and `<pct-knob invalid>` reads `''` false. Read as nothing, it let the base's `booleanAttribute` stand for the knob's: the input passed (measured). It hides the base's member, and point 3 refuses the knob.
message: libs/components/widget/src/knob.ts: PctKnob has no `invalid`, only a declaration that is no member at libs/components/widget/src/knob.ts:48
